services.name: Memorial Sign Program
services.desc: The City of Marysville's Memorial Sign Program gives families a meaningful way to honor a loved one who lost their life in a traffic incident on a city street. Each memorial sign includes the person's name and a traffic safety message, serving as both a lasting tribute and a reminder for everyone to drive safely. During the program's first year, the city will also accept applications for eligible traffic fatalities that occurred before 2026. To respect the wishes of all family members, the city will not install or maintain a memorial sign if an immediate family member objects in writing. blurb: Explore the rich history of the Marysville Opera House, a cultural gem steeped in stories and memories. Originally constructed by the Independent Order of Oddfellows, this historic venue has witnessed a myriad of events, from world-class musical performances to New York productions and charming grade-school talent shows.
